title: feat(p1closed): whether cov1>0 is equivalent to selector P
science: Refutes the k-independence of the #6494 selector: cov1>0 is NOT equivalent to P=(wt1=1 and (adj2,vertex3,mixed3)!=(0,0,0)). P is necessary but not sufficient at |S|=1 (N_P=14, N_pos=8, N_both=8; six P-maps have cov1=0; lex-first counterexample (1,0,0,0,1)). So the coverage selector is seed-size dependent.
